title: What The Guitar Knows (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 102bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritola male vocal music philosophy absurdist Wilma family guitar
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The guitar is democratic — it goes everywhere the owner goes
It fits in a case the size of a child and nobody knows
It's there until it comes out at a gathering of some kind
And then it becomes the furniture of everyone's mind

[Pre-Chorus]
There is always someone at the campfire who can play three chords
And those three chords have covered most of what the canon affords

[Chorus]
What does the guitar know that I don't know?
It knows that three chords and the truth is the whole show
What does the guitar know in the hands of someone good?
It knows that music lives in wood and wire — always would
That's my boy

[Verse 2]
The classical guitar is different from the acoustic folk
And the electric is different from them both — no joke
Each version of the guitar has its own particular voice
And the player brings another voice on top — that's the choice

[Bridge]
My Wilma plays guitar better than I ever will
She plays it like she's talking to someone on a hill
In the light of an Australian afternoon with the birds doing their part
The guitar in her hands sounds like whatever's in her heart

[Outro]
Guitar knows… three chords and the truth… guitar knows
That's my boy
